strengths.comment: However清楚标出转折，使让步部分与前面的支持理由形成对比。

issues.quote: In conclusion, public transport should be the priority, but some roads are still necessary.
issues.comment: 结论和前面的理由全部挤在同一段里，全文没有分段，影响整体连贯性。
issues.suggestion: 至少分成引言段、主体段和结论段；如有两个理由，可用两个主体段分别展开。

rejected_attempts.semantic_assessment: 识别97词/单段及展开不足有依据，已接受限定立场；载客量机制可深化而非不存在。让步后要求再次重申优先，仍忽视紧接的结论。无最终可交付评价。

model_output.quote: Country A had the highest level of ownership in both years
model_output.comment: 2000年A的约70%高于其他三国；但2020年C的近80%高于A的约75%，所以“both years”不成立。

full_original_paragraphs: Overall, car ownership increased in all four countries over the period, although the size of the rise varied considerably. Country A had the highest level of ownership in both years, while Country D remained the lowest.
In 2000, around 70% of households in Country A owned a car, compared with roughly 55% in Country B and about 40% in Country C. Country D had by far the lowest figure, at only 15%.

By 2020, the percentage in Country A had risen slightly to about 75%, and Country B had grown to approximately 65%. The most dramatic change was seen in Country C, where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, overtaking Country A. Country D also experienced significant growth, reaching around 35%, but it was still well behind the other three countries.
task1_consistency_review.assessment: 评论正确识别2020年C近80>A约75，否定both years有据；但 figures 列表为2000的70/55/40，不能作为该矛盾的决定性结构化支持。所有引用存在不等于证据选择正确。
